findings.detail: F1: Lane handoff (handoffs/lane_source_probe_handoff.json) deviates from the strict zcode_orch_v3_handoff@1 field shapes: tests[] entries carry {name, verdict} without command/exit_code/log_digest, outputs[] are bare path strings without {path, sha256}, and recommended_next_action is absent. Substance independently verified by A7 (tests re-run 4/4 PASS; outputs exist and are digested in retrieval_manifest.json), so the verdict is unaffected — but the Lead's orchestrator_validate_handoff may flag it; fix shape at integration, do not re-dispatch the lane for it.

F2: authority_claims[] is non-empty in a lane handoff (schema notes 'normally EMPTY for lane agents'). The three entries are compliance statements ('followed plan §…; no Jev calls, no PnL, no registry edits, no push'), not authorization claims, so the refusal rule for lane authority claims is not triggered in substance.

F3: The A7 dispatch packet names audited HEAD 'e49c23cff682ab15507651078f399dd48e9260d' — 39 hex, differing at char 34 from the real HEAD e49c23cff682ab15507651078f399dd485e9260d. Prefix is unique on this branch; lane's own handoff commit_sha is correct; measured HEAD used throughout this audit. Dispatch record typo for the owner to correct.

F4: Counting phrasing in the verdict artifacts: '195/195 non-empty files decode' includes the 2 boundary files (window non-empty = 193, matching scale_evidence.json files_with_ticks=193; 193+2+47=242 reconciles exactly), and gap_census count=45 includes the weekend 2820-min entry while the prose says '44 micro-gaps' (44 micro + 1 weekend = 45). Arithmetic reconciles in both cases; phrasing only.

F5: Dukascopy license search breadth: two cited pages plus one probed 404 path are recorded; no other candidate terms locations (e.g. JForex/data-licensing pages) were probed. The UNCLEAR status errs conservative (safe direction), a missed blanket-clearance page is unlikely given the TCU written-consent clause for automated acquisition, and resolution is owner action regardless — recorded so the owner knows the search was narrow, not exhaustive.

verdict_rationale: Plan §1 requires the Dukascopy license be resolvable; UNCLEAR ⇒ CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED ⇒ the verdict cannot be QUALIFIED. Plan §3 P1: license unresolved is a PROBE_FAIL trigger and 'PROBE_FAIL stops the cycle at the matching BLOCKED_* verdict' — the matching enum is BLOCKED_SOURCE_LICENSE. No reading justifies stage 2: plan §0a forbids full-history while license is unclear, and proceeding without Dukascopy would be fatal anyway since Twelve Data has no bid/ask on this plan (BLOCKED_COST_AUTHORITY would follow). All technical claims re-verified from bytes: every number in the claim reproduces exactly. Findings are phrasing/shape-level; none breaks the claim.
owner_decision_required: The cycle cannot unblock itself: LICENSE_RESOLVED requires either (a) documented Dukascopy prior express written consent for automated retrieval of the public datafeed for internal research, or (b) an explicit owner legal determination that the site TCU does not govern datafeed.dukascopy.com (or that personal-non-commercial reading covers this use). Technical evidence is probe-grade and P2 can start immediately upon either. Secondary owner items: correct the malformed dispatch sha (F3); decide whether Twelve Data's revocable license + §16 retention constraints are acceptable for the reconciliation role at P2 scale (bar retention currently is raw pages under gitignored data_local/).
